subject: S05 follow-ups from re-review
body: 1) SeedFailed message joins report.checks (count failures show detail). 2) MEDIUM: ui_copy must never blank UI: a REQUIRED_KEYS set (every key the web reads) validated on admin PUT (422 listing missing keys) AND a non-empty fallback in the web copy() (log once) — test that PUT without signin.submit is rejected and buttons keep an accessible name. 3) Extend ui_copy to the remaining S03 strings you own the config for (AccountPage sign-out labels, callback messages, SignInPage 'Sending…', 'Opening Google…', 'No email sent', 'Sign in' heading) — claim seg03's files and coordinate; seg06 wires content.report_issue/content.figure_missing in ReportIssueDialog (I've told them). 4) config.spec restores keys without leaving admin_edited_at set (clear the mark via an admin endpoint/param), keep it local-only, fix the skip message.
